obligations.requirement: Canonical ImageContent resolves ResourceId to deterministic encoded bytes and materializes a renderable decoded image; missing/ready transition is derived only.
obligations.oracle: bundled PNG cold/warm decode replay with source_rect and content_mode coverage

acceptance.cold_decode: one successful decode and non-empty RGBA image
acceptance.warm_decode: same resource generation yields identical digest without semantic mutation
acceptance.missing: explicit unavailable diagnostic and no pixels
acceptance.source_rect: source rectangle changes rendered sample region
acceptance.canonical_mutation: operation count and SemanticGeneration unchanged on missing->ready

obligations.requirement: Canonical RichText produces a renderer-neutral derived TextLayoutSnapshot with deterministic local bounds/fragments/shaped runs under fixed input/font/layout context/profile.
obligations.oracle: fixed-font deterministic layout fixtures + rebuild/replay equivalence
obligations.acceptance: same accepted semantic input + font bytes + LayoutContext + text profile yields reference-equivalent layout

obligations.requirement: FontResourceId resolves exact face identity without implicit platform fallback or synthetic substitution; missing/ready transitions remain derived only.
obligations.oracle: deterministic mock resolver + pinned Roboto/Noto resource tests
obligations.acceptance: exact face or explicit degraded/unavailable state; zero canonical mutation on resource transition

obligations.requirement: Production text layout replaces heuristic RichText bounds in Scene/Bounds/Spatial integration and publishes conservative old/new visual contribution.
obligations.acceptance: EditRichText updates affected text contribution; SetTransforms reuses local layout; camera/zoom causes zero relayout

obligations.requirement: The same TextLayoutSnapshot feeds Direct/NonTiled reference and production Skia rendering with no normal-frame SemanticDocument read.
obligations.oracle: reference vs production render-plan parity + zoom/DPR automated matrix

acceptance.layout_semantics: exact same TextLayoutSnapshot digest between Direct/NonTiled and production render plan

raster_profile.digest: SHA-256 recorded; exact digest required for render-plan bytes

acceptance.no_semantic_read: normal production frame path does not read SemanticDocument

obligations.requirement: EditRichText invalidation is local; unrelated RichText objects do not relayout; resource-ready, transform-only and camera-only negative controls behave as frozen.
obligations.oracle: deterministic edit traces + layout request counters
obligations.acceptance: affected object/paragraph counts match trace expectations and negative controls produce zero local relayout where required

obligations.requirement: Deterministic G5 text workload corpus and structured-grid proxy are replayable and expose text/layout/font/render metrics.
obligations.acceptance: all frozen workload families produce durable manifests/digests/metrics

obligations.requirement: Windows/Web/Android qualification hooks, bundled font/resource package, scenario selector, screenshot/trace export and exact build identity are ready for combined physical qualification.
obligations.oracle: qualification bundle self-check; no human/device observation required in P32
obligations.acceptance: bundle is reviewer-accessible and terminal status may be READY_FOR_COMBINED_G4_PHYSICAL_QUALIFICATION

obligations.requirement: Pre-G5 primitive inventory is completed and no hidden production primitive gap is silently ignored.
obligations.acceptance: Image/Resource decode-materialization row is either proven replayable or returns an explicit blocker/follow-up per current G4.7 authority
